build.qualification: Benchmark-only source snapshot adds one harness=false bench registration; production src bytes match the working tree. Clock-free accounting is separate from timing.

timing.qualification: Fixed-order per-operation clocks for every mode, with equal timer overhead retained. Borrowed dictionary views are used consistently by stateless and coordinated paths. Decode-only modes exclude source restoration/prefix rearming. Combined modes include setup and/or restoration, and setup-restore-only includes rearming then clearing with no decode; do not subtract it as an exact decode cost. Caller allocation/setup and ledger bookkeeping are excluded. All scratch allocation/drop and frame validation are included. No universal unsafe benefit or desktop idleness is claimed.

repeat_timing.qualification: Fixed-order per-operation clocks for every mode, with equal timer overhead retained. Borrowed dictionary views are used consistently by stateless and coordinated paths. Decode-only modes exclude source restoration/prefix rearming. Combined modes include setup and/or restoration, and setup-restore-only includes rearming then clearing with no decode; do not subtract it as an exact decode cost. Caller allocation/setup and ledger bookkeeping are excluded. All scratch allocation/drop and frame validation are included. No universal unsafe benefit or desktop idleness is claimed.

summary.aggregation: Equal-weight geometric mean of per-case median latency ratios over ten nonempty cases. Empty remains separate. Borrowed views are identical across paths. Prefix rearm and source restore are outside decode-only clocks and included in combined modes. Setup-restore-only sets then clears the view and is not an exact subtraction baseline. Equal timer overhead retained, no confidence intervals or general speedup claim.

qualification: Fixed-order sequential measurements on this host, with this module's required qualification passed and later incomplete matrices explicitly deferred; fresh process observations show no matched compiler/test jobs before measurement. No claim of desktop idleness, statistical significance, architecture independence or general unsafe speedup. Primary contains safe/all/21 isolated backends; independent rebuilt repeat contains safe/all. Allocation qualification is separate from timing. Every sample is retained. All measured fixture payloads are archived; unused historical binary fixtures are identified by the complete frozen source inventory rather than duplicated into this timing archive.
